ShortDescription.Value: Adjust all Transit, Passengers, Industry Trucks + Cargo, and increase Transit Line slider limits.

Publish.LongDescription:
### All Transit + Trucks (AT+T)
- Adjust public transit, passengers, fuel range, industry trucks, and cargo — without adding extra in-city UI or bloat (every fps counts).
### Public Transit - Transit lines: expand the in-game vehicle slider range (as low as 1 bus or higher 30-60). - Service / fuel range: increase how far they can travel before refueling (Bus, Train, Tram, Subway). - Passengers: change vehicle capacity - Depots: allow more vehicles per each depot.
### Industry + Cargo - Delivery capacity: Semi trucks, vans, raw material trucks, motorbikes - Total trucks: Cargo stations, extractors, warehouses, industry - Compatibility toggle if another mod also changes industry truck counts
### Notes 🚍🚋🚆✈️🚢 - *Remove* "Adjust Transit Capacity" if you install this mod. - No Harmony patch - less likely to break on patch days. - Safe to remove any time; use Reset buttons first if you want vanilla values restored.
### Compatibility - ✅ Transit Line checkbox: Pick only one mod to adjust this. Conflicts with Transit Policy Adjuster. If both are enabled, it's not going to explode, it may be inconsistent and have weird numbers, like two people changing the radio station. You can disable the checkbox for this if you prefer to use Transit Policy from another mod, but prefer all other features in this mod.
### Support and feedback - Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right). No donations requested. - Feedback and PRs welcome through GitHub and Discord (icons on the right). - All details not above might be answered in forums or in tooltips of the mod Options meu.
### Parks + Roads - Parks and Road Repairs moved to a separate new mod [Parks, Roads + Lane Wear](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/authors/River-mochi/cities_skylines_2).
### Credits - River-Mochi: author - yenyang: code review and testing. - The Transit section is inspired by Wayz's original Depot Capacity Changer. - MayorCheeks, Nukprach, BugsyG, Necko1996: testing
### Performance advantage Applies changes when needed, then goes idle. Scan Report only runs when clicked.
### 16+ Languages Supported - Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski - Português Brasileiro, Português (Portugal), Türkçe, ไทย, Українська - 한국어, 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Tiếng Việt
